result.stdout:
USAGE:
    authaz [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information   
    -v, --version    Prints version information

COMMANDS:
    login       Authenticate via device flow              
    logout      Remove stored credentials                 
    whoami      Show the current identity and organization
    validate    Validate YAML configuration locally       
    apply       Apply YAML configuration to Authaz        
    export      Export application configuration as YAML  
    org

                             https://dashboard.authaz.io)                       
        --profile            Named local session profile (default: default)     
        --identity-prefix    Identity service path prefix (default: /api). Set  
                             to empty string for host-based routing

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Apply YAML configuration to Authaz

USAGE:
    authaz apply [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                   Prints help information                        
        --dashboard-url          Dashboard BFF base URL (default:               
                                 https://dashboard.authaz.io)                   
        --profile                Named local session profile (default: default) 
        --identity-prefix        Identity service path prefix (default: /api).  
                                 Set to empty string for host-based routing     
        --application-id <ID>    Application id to apply the configuration to.  
                                 If omitted, you are prompted to pick from the  
                                 current organization                           
        --file <PATH>            Path to the YAML configuration file            
        --yes                    Skip confirmation prompt                       
        --force                  Skip ETag check
